property_summary: For any callee that implements transferFrom(address,address,uint256) and does NOT revert when invoked, C.transfer will always return true (succeeds); replacing call with staticcall breaks this when the callee's transferFrom performs a state change (staticcall will fail), so there exist inputs (a callee that mutates state inside transferFrom) where the mutant reverts while the reference succeeds.
change_summary: Change the external call to use staticcall instead of call; staticcall will revert if the callee attempts state changes, producing different observable revert behavior.
